evidence.observation: Tube pressure drifting upward through growth: 2.99 → 3.11 → 3.20 → 3.28 Torr at constant Ar 100 sccm, unlike the steady ~2.96-3.0 Torr earlier
Brief overshoot to 760.7 °C at growth onset, then settled to setpoint 750 °C
Sensor not installed; atmosphere/air-ingress cannot be verified, so a seal leak vs exhaust restriction cannot be distinguished

args.missing_evidence: An exhaust O2 reading (or equivalent leak check / RGA) plus a pump-down or Ar step-change test to see whether pressure tracks flow (leak) or stays elevated (exhaust restriction)
